scripts.check: bun --filter stitchkit check && bun --filter create-stitchkit check && bun run check:template && bun run check:scripts
scripts.test: bun --filter stitchkit test && bun --filter create-stitchkit test && bun test scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run gen:llms && bun --filter stitchkit build && bun --filter create-stitchkit build
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && cd packages/create-stitchkit/template && bun run lint:fix
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run smoke:next-ssr && bun run smoke:node && bun run consumer-lane && bun run starter-lane
scripts.sync:readme: cp README.md packages/core/README.md && bun run gen:llms
